_source: Built 2026-08-13 for the AIS-dashboard redesign (design_handoff_ais_dashboard/README.md). Two source types: (1) Reis Nordland's official 'Hovedforbindelser i Nordland / Main connections in Nordland' 2025 line map (reisnordland.no, cartography TrulsLangeCivitas, dated 2025-04-28, supplied by the user as an image -- not saved to this repo as a binary since Claude Code has no tool to extract raw bytes from a pasted chat image, only cite it), cross-referenced against (2) live web search of reisnordland.no/boreal.no/rv17.no route pages for each contract's internal Nordland fylkeskommune route code (the '18-XXX' family that also appears in this repo's NeTEx filenames, see CLAUDE.md's contract table). These two numbering systems are different: 'official_line_label' is the short public-facing number/name riders see on the map and timetable (e.g. 'NEX 1', '100'); 'internal_contract_code' is the fylkeskommune's longer administrative route code, useful for provenance but never shown to a dashboard viewer as a badge.
_correction_note: The design brief's own Design Tokens table paired 'Bodø–Væran' with NEX 1 and 'Herøy–Dønna' with '704' -- both wrong on cross-check. NEX 1 (red) is actually the long Bodø–Sørarnøy–Stokkvågen–Nesna–Sandnessjøen–Brønnøysund line, i.e. this repo's bodo-helgeland route (matches CLAUDE.md's own NOR-Line-3731_23-731_Bodo-Helgeland.xml candidate). '704' is the Brønnøysund–Sandnessjøen bus route along Kystriksvegen (FV17) -- a bus, not the Herøy–Dønna car ferry, and geographically/modally unrelated. Corrected below; route colors in frontend/src/lib/routeHelpers.ts follow this file, not the mockup's literal pairing.

bodo-helgeland.note: Nordlandsekspressen 1. Confirmed both from the real 2025 line map (red NEX1 line runs Bodø-Sørarnøy-Stokkvågen-Nesna-Sandnessjøen-Brønnøysund) and CLAUDE.md's own NeTEx filename candidate -- corrects the design brief, which mislabeled this pairing as 'Bodø–Væran'. From 2026-08-17 this route_id covers the year-round trunk service ONLY; the summer NEX1s shuttle that shares its NeTEx line was split onto its own route_id, see 'nex1s-bodo-traena-sommer' below.

nex1s-bodo-traena-sommer.note: Nordlandsekspressen 1 sommer -- the summer-only Bodø<->Træna shuttle, added 2026-08-17. Shares NeTEx line 3731 (hence the same internal_contract_code as bodo-helgeland) but is a separate operational service with its own season (real archived 2025 dates: 2025-06-23..2025-08-13, Mon-Fri), its own 10-quay itinerary and its own vessel; see data/reference/route_line_files.json's entry of the same name for the full archive evidence. 'NEX 1s' is the name the printed 2025 Reis Nordland/NOR-Line timetable itself uses for this service (see official_timetables_2025_nex1_nex2.json), so the badge is confirmed, not inferred. Color is a deep rose deliberately kept in NEX 1's red family (it IS a NEX 1 variant) while remaining separable: re-validated as a full 10-color set with the dataviz skill's validate_palette.js --mode light --surface '#fcfcfb' -- all adjacent-pair checks pass, and of the candidates tried this is the only one that leaves the set's all-pairs worst case exactly where the pre-existing 9 already put it (#eda100 vs #f0812e), i.e. it introduces no new worst pair.

bodo-svolvaer-bodo.note: Nordlandsekspressen 2, Bodø-Bogøy-Skutvik-Svolvær-Bodø. Matches both the design brief and the real map's orange NEX2 line -- the one design-brief pairing that checked out as given.

bodo-gildeskal.note: Design brief's stated pairing. '100' is reused across several disconnected Nordland corridors (also a Bodø-Fauske-Narvik bus line, also a Harstad-Tromsø boat line per Nordland's route-numbering convention of reusing short numbers per region), and web search did not turn up a page pairing '100' specifically with the Bodø-Gildeskål hurtigbåt -- plausible given the map's geography, not independently confirmed. Internal contract code 18-445 IS confirmed.

bodo-vaeran.note: Local hurtigbåt (6 stops: Bodø, Givær, Helligvær, Vokkøy, Sørlandegode, Bliksvær), confirmed internal code 18-539, but no distinct colored public line-number badge found on the 2025 overview map or in search -- likely too local a route to feature its own number on a county-wide 'main connections' map. Plain route-name badge, no pill.

helgelandspendelen.note: Sandnessjøen-Træna-Lovund-Sleneset commuter hurtigbåt (per Boreal's own route page), confirmed internal code 18-191, but referred to by name rather than a distinct public number anywhere found. Plain route-name badge, no pill.

stokkvagen-traena.note: Stokkvågen-Træna ferge. Confirmed internal code 18-192; car ferry routes on the 2025 map appear to use a dashed/grey style with an 'F'-prefixed number (like 'F782' near Værøy/Røst) rather than a bold colored pill, and Træna's own short link wasn't distinctly labeled at overview scale. Plain route-name badge, no pill.

stokkvagen-onoy-sleneset-lovund.note: Stokkvågen-Onøy-Sleneset-Lovund ferge. Confirmed internal code 18-344; same car-ferry labeling caveat as stokkvagen-traena. Plain route-name badge, no pill.

sovik-heroy.note: Søvik-Austbø-Herøy-Brasøy ferge. Confirmed internal code 18-171; positively NOT '704' (that's the unrelated Brønnøysund-Sandnessjøen bus, see _correction_note) -- no genuine public line-number badge found for this ferry. Color reassigned away from the old series-8 red now that bodo-helgeland occupies NEX1's near-identical red, re-validated with scripts/validate_palette.js (all 6 checks pass). Plain route-name badge, no pill.

sandnessjoen-donna-lokta.note: Sandnessjøen-Dønna-Løkta ferge (M/F 'Møysalen'). Confirmed internal code 18-181; positively NOT '704' (see _correction_note). Color unchanged from the existing slot-9 addition. Plain route-name badge, no pill.
